pages.text: Forge: $(l)ground weapons$(), $(l)ground armor$() and $(l)shields$() (every unit and building with shields). Cybernetics core: $(l)air weapons$() and $(l)air armor$(). Three levels each: forge levels 2-3 need a twilight council, air levels 2-3 a fleet beacon.

Each level of a weapons upgrade adds about a tenth of a strike (at least 1) to every strike of the units it is for; each armor level is 1 armor, taken off every strike that reaches health (light units have little armor, armored ones more; bonus damage against light or armored comes on top). Shields: 1 shield armor and a tenth more shields a level. The unit panel shows a unit's levels.

$(l)Charge$() (Twilight Council): Opens the zealots' charge$(br2)$(l)Blink$() (Twilight Council): Opens the stalkers' blink$(br2)$(l)Warp Gate$() (Cybernetics Core): Opens the change of gateways into warp gates
